text.aria-label: Title text 'Flag-oracle rules (O-) and stored arms minus B-mix (interim, unaudited) Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole events. Dashed: same as B-mix. Five test months, fit seed 0. Zero or above means no better than B-mix.'
text.tspan: Flag-oracle rules (O-) and stored arms minus B-mix (interim, unaudited)
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole events. Dashed: same as B-mix.
Five test months, fit seed 0. Zero or above means no better than B-mix.
